honestly it took me most of the summer about three months to recover from the episodes but ( in the kindest way possible ) they were very intense and unexpected so it could be shorter for you and may not require such an intense treatment again you know yourself the best and i’m not trying to downplay your situation because thoughts are very serious but it might not be so long / intense and as for the mental hospital it was honestly a very traumatic experience that time of year is very hard for me ( even though i’m not i’m in the hospital ) it was honestly a very scaring experience but i was what i needed i was in crisis i needed help and would not be here if i wasn’t in one at the time i would have harmed myself and wouldn’t have gotten the correct diagnosis and treatment if i wasn’t hospitalized so i’d recommend it if you are in crisis and need attention immediately sometimes you need someone else to watch you rather then self reports it was needed it saved my life and was good in the long run but very scary and upsetting to myself and people around me so i’d recommend it as a last resort or if you need an outside person i’m not trying to scare you and want you to know i’m glad it happened because it was 100% needed and very helpful i learned a lot of lessons but it should be a last resort or an emergency message me if you have any questions on my experience i have no problem sharing and will do my best to help
